description: This file is a Makefile defining build rules, device configurations, and image build steps for a Chromium OS-related project targeting specific devices such as ASUS OnHub and TP-Link OnHub routers.

methods.name: Device/dsa-migration
methods.description: Configuration related to device migration handling; defines version and message.

methods.name: Build/cros-gpt
methods.description: Build step to generate a GPT partition table for Chrome OS device images.

methods.name: Build/append-kernel-part
methods.description: Append kernel image to the build output, using specified partition size.

methods.name: Build/cros-vboot
methods.description: Create verification blob for Chrome OS bootloader with UUID substitution.

methods.name: Device/OnhubImage
methods.description: Defines image build process for OnHub devices, including kernel, images, and device-specific packages.

methods.name: Device/asus_onhub
methods.description: Device configuration for ASUS OnHub including image build and device info.

methods.name: Device/tplink_onhub
methods.description: Device configuration for TP-Link OnHub including image build and device info.
